test.title: Classification of Elements and Periodicity in Properties - Test 4

test.syllabus: This test contains questions from all topics of this chapter included in the JEE Main syllabus. It includes a mix of questions from PYQs of JEE Main 2019 - 2025.

question.text:

Reason (R): covalent and ionic radii in a particular oxidation state increases down the group.
